description: The payment provider's form is embedded in the payment page as an iframe titled Payment. Pay opens the 3-D Secure window; after the shopper confirms there, the payment page shows the payment as paid.
acceptanceCriteria: Paying with a 16-digit card number opens the 3-D Secure window.
After Confirm in the 3-D Secure window the payment page shows the status Paid.

comments.author: designer
comments.body: Test ids: card-number and pay in the widget, confirm-3ds in the 3-D Secure window, payment-status on the page.
